ordered_operations: execute the production league-mulligan procedure once for each legal keep attempt
draw candidate hands in the fixed 7, 7, 6, 5, 4 sequence
return every rejected hand to the remaining library and invoke the supplied shuffle
keep at 7, 7, 6, 5, and 4 across the five executions
draw exactly seven minus kept-size refill cards
reject an attempted keep after the four-card candidate
preconditions: The binding league override, not the London mulligan, controls this procedure.
The test supplies a deterministic shuffle function so returned-card preservation and shuffle invocation are observable.
required_assertions: the production procedure consumes candidate sizes exactly 7, 7, 6, 5, and 4
every rejected hand is returned to the remaining library before the shuffle function is invoked
each legal keep attempt produces the expected prefix of candidate hand sizes
every kept hand is refilled to exactly seven cards
an attempted keep after the four-card candidate is rejected

plain_english: The production league procedure presents an initial seven-card hand, one free replacement seven-card hand, and then six-, five-, and four-card candidates.
Whenever a candidate is rejected, its cards are returned to the remaining library and the configured shuffle function is executed before the next candidate is drawn.
The test executes every legal keep point, refills each kept hand to seven, and proves that the procedure cannot continue below the four-card candidate.
title: League mulligan executes a free second seven, returned-hand shuffles, a four-card floor, and refill to seven
